title: feat(samek16): nu same-k reverse holds for every k=1..5 on B16
science: Key contrast with the doubled-pair sweeps: under the SAME-k comparator ((k,0,0) vs (k,k,k), equal coordinate rather than equal l1) nu reverses for EVERY k=1..5 on B_16(0) (27>25, 108>64, 243>121, 300>196, 363>289), whereas the doubled comparator dies at k>=3 (#6773). So the verdict is a function of which comparator is chosen, not of the rule alone. Also exposes a crossover: t(k,0,0)=3k exactly for
verdict_pair: same-k reverse: YES for every k=1,2,3,4,5
